description: Testable hypothesis development and reproducible experimental or observational study design without unrelated literature or manuscript tooling.

rules.reason: The requested workflow needs explicit hypotheses and a defensible study design.

interface.short_description: Turn a question into a defensible study design.
interface.long_description: Develops testable hypotheses, rival explanations, predictions, measurements, randomization, blocking, and reproducible study layouts.
interface.default_prompt: Help me turn this research question into a testable study design.
